edgar_concentrations.excerpt: HPS revenue for Q3 2026 increased 70% to approximately $2.3 billion compared to Q3 2025, and accounted for 40% of our total Q3 2026 revenue (Q3 2025 — 44% of our total Q3 2025 revenue). Our HPS revenue for YTD 2026 increased 64% to approximately $5.9 billion compared to YTD 2025, and accounted for 41% of our total YTD 2026 revenue (YTD 2025 — 42% of our total YTD 2025 revenue). HPS revenue growth was driven by program ramps across multiple hyperscaler customers. Compute & Storage end market revenue increased $1,139.0 million (242%) in Q3 2026 compared to Q3 2025 and increased $2,279.7 million (173%) in YTD 2026 compared to YTD 2025, driven by the continued growth in hyperscaler AI compute volumes and strength in our storage programs. ATS segment revenue increased $176.4 million (23%) in Q3 2026 compared to Q3 2025, and increased $244.4 million (10%) in YTD 2026 compared to YTD 2025, primarily due to acceleration in our Capital Equipment business, as well as increased demand in each of our other businesses. We depend on a small number of customers for a substantial portion of our revenue. In the aggregate, our top 10 customers represented 85% of total revenue for Q3 2026 and 84% of total revenue for YTD 2026 (Q3 2025 — 80%; YTD 2025 — 79%). Three customers (all in our CCS segment) individually represented 10% or more of total revenue in Q3 2026 (35%, 17% and 14%) and YTD 2026 (34%, 16% and 15%). Three customers (all in our CCS segment) individually represented 10% or more of total revenue in Q3 2025 (30%, 15% and 14%) and in YTD 2025 (30%, 14% and 12%). Gross profit: The following table shows gross profit and gross margin (gross profit as a percentage of total revenue) for the periods indicated: Three months ended September 30 Nine months ended September 30 2026 2025 2026 2025 Gross profit (in millions) $ 640.8 $ 416.1 $ 1,655.5 $ 1,061.0 Gross margin 11.0 % 13.0 % 11.4 % 12.1 % Gross profit increased by 54% or $224.7 million to $640.8 million in Q3 2026 compared to Q3 2025 and increased by 56% or $594.5 million to $1,655.5 million in YTD 2026 compared to YTD 2025, primarily driven by our strong revenue growth. Gross margin decreased to 11.0% in Q3 2026 from 13.0% in Q3 2025 and decreased to 11.4% in YTD 2026 from 12.1% in YTD 2025. Both gross profit and gross margin were negatively impacted by the unfavorable changes in the fair value adjustments (TRS FVAs) related to our total return swap agreement (TRS Agreement) recorded in cost of sales ($0.9 million loss in Q3 2026 compared to $48.5 million gain in Q3 2025; $40.0 million gain in YTD 2026 compared to $81.6 million gain in YTD 2025), as well as mix dynamics in our CCS business.

triggers.text:
§15｜複審觸發與保質期

# | 重新評估觸發點 | 類型 | 具體時間/條件
1 | Q2 FY2026 財報（客戶集中度 >10% 揭露、CCS 毛利率、2026 guide） | 財報日期 | 2026-07-28
2 | 1.6T 交換機 2H2026 量產進度；Inventec/Foxconn AI 伺服器/交換機出貨份額 | 產業事件 | 2H2026
3 | Fwd PE FY1 回落 ≤28x（約 $285） | 價位觸發 | 持續監測
4 | §3.F Single Thing：交換機段二供 / 某 >10% 客戶 CCS 營收 YoY 轉負 | Single Thing | 季度法說/10-K
5 | Pomerantz/Portnoy 詐欺調查是否正式起訴 | 法律程序 | ~2026 Q3-Q4

保質期：2026-07-28（Q2 財報）前有效，或 §3.F 觸發時立即失效。
最可能的 upside 因素：Q2 再度大 beat + guide 上調 + 1.6T 量產如期 + 二供止於 TPU 段（交換機守住）→ durability 增強、觀望轉進場。
最可能的 downside 因素：第二家大客戶二供 / capex 拐頭 / 調查正式起訴 → 倍數 + EPS 雙殺。

反向 critic（錯過成本）正面回應：獨立冷讀提出兩個「該進場」最強論點，本裁決正面回應而非覆述：(1) 「等更便宜倍數」是否偽命題？——部分成立。股價已從 ATH −24%、共識 +14.7% 同步壓縮隱含倍數，SMCI 式崩解與「三次上調 guide + Q1 record OM」矛盾，等「更便宜倍數」在快速上修的名字上可能只等到「更貴的分母」。本裁決據此修正：觀望的主因不再主打「倍數見頂會崩」（證據較弱），而是「集中度 65% + Google 二供 + 詐欺調查 + CEO $55M 賣股」四件事同月疊加、且小倉衛星無法對沖單一客戶份額被替代的 thesis 級減損——這是獨立於估值的結構風險。(2) FY28 EPS 是否被低估使 IRR 被算低？——有道理。共識落後於三次連續上修（早期成長股 S 曲線特徵），若 FY28 EPS 錨定在已被證明錯三次的舊模型，Base IRR 8.4%/AR 1.8 可能系統性偏低。本裁決承認此點：故 rearm 不僅是價格錨（≤$285），也包含「結構風險量化明朗」的事件錨——若 Q2/Q3 證明二供止於 TPU 段、集中度回落，即使倍數未大跌也可升級小倉進場（承認 IRR 可能被低估，用事件錨而非死等價格）。結論：觀望站得住，但錨從「等倍數崩」修正為「等結構風險量化 + 補安全邊際」。

qa_flags.question: JPMorgan（Cardoso）要求給 2027 淨現金使用的範圍與現金週期天數
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未給範圍或週期天數，改談 2026 FCF 下修、8 月增資足夠、2028 年目標轉正。

qa_flags.question: BNP（Ackerman）問交換器複雜度提升對毛利率的貢獻，以及伺服器/L11 毛利率能否改善
qa_flags.response_pattern: Dorwart 只答公司能選擇專案、毛利為考量因素，話說到一半被 CFO 接手；CFO 改談毛利率 11% 出頭與營業槓桿，未直接回答伺服器或 L11 毛利。

qa_flags.question: BofA（Bhattacharya）問現有廠區能支撐多少營收
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 明確表示不給與產能掛鉤的營收數字，只說 2027 投資足以支撐 2027 與 2028 需求。

qa_flags.question: BofA（Bhattacharya）問回購是否主要用來抵銷股權激勵，或可能成為有意義的資本回報
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 未直接回答抵銷股權激勵與否，只說時機看機會、優先有機成長、更新 NCIB 是加拿大年度規定。

qa_flags.question: Canaccord（Young）問稼動率相關歷史量化數字與維持高稼動率對達成 9% 營益率的重要性
qa_flags.response_pattern: Mandeep 未給任何量化稼動率數字，只說高稼動率是刻意經營，並說 2027 預期高稼動率。

qa_flags.question: RBC（Treiber）問供應可得性是否比設計能力更重要，以及完整機櫃方案的競爭者是否變少
qa_flags.response_pattern: Dorwart 未直接回答兩者何者較重，承認有新增競爭者；Mandeep 補充稱 1.6T/800G 競爭者較少，但舉例仍以性質描述為主。
